metadata.description: A standing team of expert colleagues for your projects: hire them, run review rounds, talk with them one-to-one or in meetings.

plugins.name: colleagues
plugins.description: Skill and hook: set up a team of expert colleagues, hire, fire and portray them, run review rounds, talk with them one-to-one or in meetings.

plugins.description: Mod: a panel of the colleagues with portraits, who is at work and the steps they report, the week's budget; meetings drawn as a group chat, with controls to invite, let go and close.
